origin.usage: nchar_sgr(x, type = "chars", allowNA = FALSE, keepNA = NA, warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE))

arguments.name: allowNA
arguments.text: Return NA for invalid UTF-8 instead of stopping.

arguments.name: keepNA
arguments.text: How a missing string is counted.

origin.details: nchar_ctl with ctl set to sgr.

arguments.name: allowNA
arguments.text: Return NA for invalid UTF-8 instead of stopping.

arguments.name: keepNA
arguments.text: How a missing string is counted.

translation.details: nchar_ctl with ctl set to sgr. A string is a length-one vector, and None is a missing string.
translation.example:
from fansi import nchar_sgr
print('nchar_sgr("\\033[31m123") returns %s.' % nchar_sgr("\x1b[31m123")[0])
